_comment: Reviewed MISATTRIBUTED verdicts accepted as correct. One entry per (advisory, CVE, package); every field is required. Remove an entry when the validator reports it as stale.

exceptions.reason: android-mail ships all jakarta.mail classes, incl. the com/sun/mail/smtp transport (the vulnerable SMTP code); GHSA lists only jakarta.mail and angus smtp.
avro-android shares 363 of 364 classes with avro, incl. io/BinaryDecoder (the vulnerable code); GHSA lists only avro.
avro-android shares 363 of 364 classes with avro, incl. Schema and specific/SpecificData (the vulnerable code); GHSA lists only avro.
xalan-bcel-6.6.1 is the Xalan engine (XSLTC compiler + bundled BCEL) shipped under this artifact name; xalan:xalan is not shipped. GHSA lists only xalan:xalan.
